```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(stringr)
```


```{r}
# path to your folder
data_dir <- "osfstorage-archive"

# get all CSV file paths
files <- list.files(data_dir, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

# read and combine all participant data
allData <- map_dfr(files, function(file) {
  # extract filename without extension
  filename <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(file))
  
  # split into userID and ProlificID (e.g., "0a47vby8mu_67ea38f2f2477e3cbdb8202a")
  parts <- strsplit(filename, "_")[[1]]
  userID <- parts[1]
  ProlificID <- parts[2]
  
  # read the CSV and add both IDs
  read_csv(file) %>%
    mutate(userID = userID,
           ProlificID = ProlificID)
})

prolificData <- read_csv("prolificData.csv") %>% 
  rename("ProlificID" = 'Participant id')

lookupTable <- allData %>% 
  filter(!is.na(bias)) %>% 
  select(ProlificID,userID,term,bias,exposure,valence) %>% 
  unique() %>% 
  left_join(prolificData, by='ProlificID') %>% 
  select(c(userID,term,bias,exposure,valence,'U.s. political affiliation',Age,Sex)) %>% 
  rename('politicalParty' = 'U.s. political affiliation') %>% 
  mutate(
    alignment = case_when(
      politicalParty == "Democrat" & bias == "left" ~ "aligned",
      politicalParty == "Republican" & bias == "right" ~ "aligned",
      TRUE ~ 'disaligned'
    )
  ) %>% 
  mutate(
    termLength = str_length(term)
  )
  
  

lexicalDecision <- allData %>% 
  filter(category == "LexicalDecision") %>% 
  mutate(
    isCorrectCorrected = case_when(
      statusCheck == "correct" ~ 1,
      TRUE ~ 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  select(-c("term","exposure","valence","bias")) %>% 
  rename("term" = stimulus)

lexicalDecisionCoded <- lexicalDecision %>%
  left_join(lookupTable, by = c("userID", "term"))

```

# Lexical Decision Time

```{r}
lexicalDecisionCoded %>% 
  filter(!is.na(valence)) %>% 
  group_by(exposure) %>% 
  summarise(
    meanRt = mean(rt, na.rm = TRUE),
    seRt = sd(rt, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = exposure, y = meanRt, color = exposure)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = meanRt - seRt, ymax = meanRt + seRt), width = 0.2) +
  theme_bw() 
  # facet_grid(alignment ~ valence) +
  # labs(y = "Mean RT (ms)", x = "Exposure", color = "Exposure")
```


```{r}
lexicalDecisionCoded %>% 
  filter(!is.na(valence)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = termLength, y = rt, color = exposure)) + 
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_smooth(method='lm') + 
  theme_bw() 
```



## Lexical Decision Acc

```{r}
lexicalDecisionCoded %>% 
  group_by(status, exposure) %>% 
  mutate(meanAcc = mean(isCorrectCorrected)) %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=exposure, y=meanAcc, color = exposure)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  theme_bw() + 
  facet_wrap(~status)
```
